label: configure debug
command: CUDACXX=/usr/local/cuda/bin/nvcc CUDAToolkit_ROOT=/usr/local/cuda VULKAN_SDK=/home/marcel/Programs/VulkanSDK/current cmake -S . -B build/debug -DCMAKE_C_COMPILER=/usr/bin/gcc-15 -DCMAKE_CXX_COMPILER=/usr/bin/g++-15 -DCMAKE_CUDA_HOST_COMPILER=/usr/bin/g++-15 -DCMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=Debug -DNR_CUDA_ARCH=86 -DNR_BUILD_PYTHON=ON -DCMAKE_EXPORT_COMPILE_COMMANDS=ON && rm -f build/current && cmake -E create_symlink debug build/current

label: configure release
command: CUDACXX=/usr/local/cuda/bin/nvcc CUDAToolkit_ROOT=/usr/local/cuda VULKAN_SDK=/home/marcel/Programs/VulkanSDK/current cmake -S . -B build/release -DCMAKE_C_COMPILER=/usr/bin/gcc-15 -DCMAKE_CXX_COMPILER=/usr/bin/g++-15 -DCMAKE_CUDA_HOST_COMPILER=/usr/bin/g++-15 -DCMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=Release -DNR_CUDA_ARCH=86 -DNR_BUILD_PYTHON=ON -DCMAKE_EXPORT_COMPILE_COMMANDS=ON && rm -f build/current && cmake -E create_symlink release build/current

label: run pynoorray
command:
cmake --build build/current --target _pynoorray -j$(nproc) && PYTHONPATH=$ZED_WORKTREE_ROOT/build/current/lib python - <<'PY'
import pynoorray
from pynoorray.training import GaussianTrainer
r = pynoorray.RenderSession(64, 64)
print(pynoorray.RenderSession, hasattr(r, 'set_gaussian_opacity'), GaussianTrainer)
PY
